title: Trustworthy Social Bias Measurement
findings: Debiasing methods (Hard/Soft from Manzini et al., 2019) that target religious bias in word embeddings successfully reduce bias according to their own metric, but are found to amplify bias when measured by the paper's proposed, more trustworthy metric.
